newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS CUTS TV OPS JOBS IN BELGIUM, FRANCE, ITALY.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS CUTS TV OPS JOBS IN BELGIUM, FRANCE, ITALY.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it was restructuring television operations in Belgium, France and Italy as part of a previously announced restructuring of its Sound and Vision unit.
It said jobs at the three sites would fall by 50 percent to around 1,400 as a result of the restructuring in 1997.
Philips in July announced that developments in the consumer electionics industry meant a restructuring of its activities was necessary, especially in Europe.
The company took an 800 million guilder second quarter charge for the restructuring and said in July it would cut 6,000 jobs in the division over 18 months.
The Sound and Vision unit comprises television, audio, video equipment and interactive media systems.
The three plants -- at Bruges in Belgium, Dreux in France and Monza in Italy -- are involved in manufacturing and development.

The restructuring changes mean Monza will stop its activities in mid-1997, while Bruges will be the worldwide high-end colour television development centre with a production facility. Dreux will be the final assembly centre for western Europe.
Dreux will also have a limited development capacity for the regional adaptations of global product platforms.
Philips has already announced restructuring of plants in Krefeld and Nuremburg in Germany; Dendermonde in Belgium and Vienna in Austria.
Together with today's restructuring some 2,500 jobs are being cut in the division's industrial activities in western Europe.

In marketing and sales some 850 jobs in 16 European countries have been cut, while 350 research and development jobs are also going. Together with 150 jobs in staff departments the total western European job cuts will be around 3,900.
Philips said the Sound and Vision restructuring process was on schedule, while further actions were being prepared for its operations in the rest of the world.

Philips employs 270,000 people in 60 countries. The Consumer Products division, which includes Sound and Vision, employed a total workforce of over 70,000 as at end-June. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
